name: Grace Kim
headline: Analytics Engineer
summary: Analytics engineer with 4 years turning raw commerce and media data into tested, documented models that business teams actually use.

experience.title: Analytics Engineer
bullets: Own 300 dbt models on Snowflake covering orders, returns and marketing spend, all with tests and docs.
Schedule the dbt and Spark jobs in Airflow, with freshness alerts that page the data team before the 9 a.m. trading meeting.
Rewrote the attribution logic in SQL and cut the marketing dashboard refresh from 40 minutes to 6.
Built the Looker explores that 120 merchandisers use for weekly reviews.

experience.title: Junior Data Engineer
bullets: Built Spark jobs in Python that sessionise 300 million streaming events a day.
Maintained Airflow DAGs for the audience-measurement pipeline and fixed its recurring backfill failures.
Wrote SQL quality checks for the subscriptions tables and kept the pipeline code in Git.
